findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_photos, search_photos_by_image, get_photo_file_by_photo_id, get_grid_selected_photos · Private data: search_photos, search_photos_by_image, get_photo_file_by_photo_id, get_grid_selected_photos · Public sink: search_photos, get_photo_file_by_photo_id · Destructive: search_photos_by_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_photos, search_photos_by_image, get_photo_file_by_photo_id, get_grid_selected_photos · Private data: search_photos, search_photos_by_image, get_photo_file_by_photo_id, get_grid_selected_photos · Public sink: search_photos, get_photo_file_by_photo_id · Destructive: search_photos_by_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
